p.espaces.rg_d: Customs, product standards, starting a business, investment platform: the official sources of each country.
p.espaces.rg_sub: The rules change frequently: ONE WORLD does not copy them, it opens up the official sources updated, then you read them in your own language.
p.espaces.rg_g1: Global Trade Helpdesk (ITC, UNCTAD, WTO): for a product and a country, customs, taxes, rules and procedures on one page
p.espaces.rg_g2: Market Access Map (ITC): Customs Duties and Rules of Origin
p.espaces.rg_g3: ePing (WTO): standards, labels and health regulations that this country sets for products
p.espaces.rg_e1: Access2Markets: Trade with and from the EU, step by step
p.espaces.rg_e2: TARIC: Customs and tax codes for imports into the EU
p.espaces.rg_b1: Business Ready (World Bank): starting a business, tax, international trade, country by country
p.espaces.rg_i1: I-SCAN (IOSCO): checks if a platform has not been marked by a regulatory body before trusting it with money
p.espaces.rg_note: A page opens in its language: use the browser's translation, or "Understand a document" for a document. For a critical decision, ask an expert in that country.

p.espaces.cu_t2: Access2Markets (EU): taxes, duties, rules of origin, steps
p.espaces.cu_t3: TARIC: Customs codes (HS codes) and taxes on importation into the European Union
p.espaces.cu_d3: Transport documents: Consignment Note (sea), Air Consignment Note (air), CMR (road)
p.espaces.cu_d5: EORI number (importing or exporting business in the EU)
p.espaces.cu_d6: Depending on the product: sanitary or phytosanitary certificate, license, CE standard
p.espaces.cu_i1: EXW: The buyer handles everything from the seller's factory.
p.espaces.cu_i2: FCA: The seller delivers the goods that have been exported to the buyer's shipping company.
p.espaces.cu_i3: FOB: the seller carries the goods on board the ship; after that, risk and cost are the buyer's.
p.espaces.cu_i4: CIF: The seller pays the freight and insurance to the port of arrival.
p.espaces.cu_i5: DAP: Seller delivers to destination, buyer pays import duties.
p.espaces.cu_i6: DDP: the seller pays all, including import duties.

p.espaces.mt_sub: 24/24 ONE WORLD does not send money itself and does not earn anything from these links: you compare here, then you send with the service of your choice.

p.espaces.mt_k1: See the total amount received: fee + exchange rate. a rate worse than the market is a hidden cost.

p.espaces.mt_k3: An ID document is usually required, both for sending and for collecting.

p.espaces.ds_d: Selling without stock: finding a supplier, calculating a realistic price, complying with the law.
p.espaces.ds_sub: Dropshipping means selling a product that the supplier ships directly to your customer.
p.espaces.ds_s1: Choose a product that is permitted in the customer's country: no counterfeit, no regulated product without a license.
p.espaces.ds_s2: Find a supplier ("Wholesaler/Supplier" list here or wholesale platform) and order a sample before you sell.
p.espaces.ds_s3: Find out the actual price: product, shipping, customs duties, VAT of the customer's country, payment and return fees.
p.espaces.ds_s4: Let the customer know the actual delivery time.
p.espaces.ds_s5: Register your activity: business status, VAT and taxes according to your country (see trade regulations).
p.espaces.ds_s6: Comply with customer rights: clear prices include taxes, right of return, warranty, data protection.
p.espaces.ds_w1: A supplier wants to pay in full by unsecured bank transfer or by virtual currency.
p.espaces.ds_w2: Paid courses promise to make you rich quickly.
